body:
Triage (maintainer-authorized one-off pass #2, 2026-08-09, registered on #6015): **promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, routed `domain:devx` — and escalated to the maintainer's attention in this round's report as the day's most urgent item.** The steward's evidence is complete: two ADR files landed on main today (via #6942 and #6962) with the governance gate red and zero maintainer review, because the gate is not in the required-check set — the third-in-one-day instance of the #6741 discipline failing on paper enforcement. The durable fix is one maintainer settings action (add the gate's check context to the `main` ruleset's required set — verify the exact context name from a recent check-run list before adding) plus enrolling that name in #6865's guard. The card also carries the post-hoc review question for the two unapproved ADR merges, which is the maintainer's alone.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Settings action complete (2026-08-09 ~12:0xZ): `ADR maintainer approval` is now in the `main` ruleset's required set** — added by the maintainer, with the job-name-vs-workflow-name trap explicitly checked (the correct job-level context was selected from the picker, not the workflow title).

Remaining on this card, in order:

1. **Acceptance observation**: the next PR touching `docs/adr/**` that enters the merge queue must be observed BLOCKED while the gate is red and merging only after the maintainer's own approval turns it green (the #6981 flow, now with teeth). The queue steward's next scan naturally covers this; whoever observes it posts the evidence here and this card closes.
2. **Guard enrollment**: recorded on #6865 (the pinned set is now six names; the guard also asserts the workflow's three triggers survive).
3. **Post-hoc review of the two unapproved merges** (maintainer's action, tracked here until done): #6962 (ADR-0094 D5-R — fully PM-reviewed pre-merge, recommendation was approve; a retroactive approving review closes the record) and #6942 (ADR-0045 — NOT yet maintainer-reviewed; walkthrough or revert is the maintainer's call).

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Re-routed `pm:queue` → `needs-user-decision`** by the `domain:devx` PM seat (`session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`). This card is not dispatchable: the gate itself works (it fails correctly — the card's own control case #6981 proves the intended flow end to end), and both remedies are repository-settings and governance actions no agent seat can perform. Dispatching a dev here would produce nothing but a report saying the same.

**This is the escalation of an already-standing request.** The `ADR maintainer approval` check has been code-complete on `main` since ~01:00Z tonight (#6802, merged), and its Half 2 — adding it to the required-check set in Settings → Rulesets — has been on the maintainer's list all night as "code present but not yet effective." This card upgrades that from *pending hardening* to *measured bypass with two specimens*:

- **#6942** merged 06:32Z with the gate red and **zero reviews** → `docs/adr/0045-additive-materialization-and-visibility-gate.md`
- **#6962** merged 08:37Z, same shape → `docs/adr/0094-sys-permission-set-pure-projection.md`
- The queue demonstrably kept stacking on #6962's result commit four minutes after its governance gate went red.

**Two decisions, both maintainer-only:**

1. **Settings → Rulesets (main):** add `ADR Merge Approval` to the required-check set — both branch-protection required checks and the merge-queue check set, so a red result kicks the entry instead of riding along. (Same screen as the standing #6802 Half 2 request; one visit closes both.)
2. **The two ADRs already on `main`:** ratify ADR-0045 and ADR-0094 retroactively, or revert and re-land them through the approval path. ⛔ No agent seat should self-serve either direction — reverting an ADR is itself an ADR-touching change under the #6741 ruling.

One cross-reference for the same visit: `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` (merged tonight, #6983) is the repo-side registry of what the required set is believed to contain. If `ADR Merge Approval` is added to the settings, adding a row there keeps the registry honest — that half IS dispatchable, and this seat will queue it once the settings change is confirmed.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Maintainer has applied the repo-settings half (2026-08-10 ~02:3xZ)** — confirmed directly to the devx PM seat with a screenshot of the `main` ruleset: `ADR maintainer approval` is in the required status checks (correct check-run name, alongside TypeScript Type Check / ESLint / Test Core / Dogfood Regression Gate / Build Core), and the Code Owners review requirement was being enabled in the same visit.

**Claim (dispatchable half)** — devx PM seat, session `session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`, branch `claude/issue-7022-pin-adr-required-context`.

Dispatching the machine-closure line now: register `ADR maintainer approval` in `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`'s expected-required set, so any future drift in the repo settings (the check being removed from the required list, silently) turns CI red instead of reopening this incident class. This half was explicitly blocked on the settings existing; that blocker just cleared.

⛔ **The other half of this card stays with the maintainer**: ratify or roll back ADR-0045 (#6942) and ADR-0094 (#6962), which landed with the gate red and zero approvals before the setting existed. Rolling back an ADR is itself an ADR change, so no AI seat touches it either way. This card should not close until that call is made.

If an earlier claim comment with a different session ID exists above this one, that claim wins and this one should be treated as withdrawn.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Disposition record (devx PM seat, 2026-08-10 ~03:5xZ)** — the maintainer confirmed directly to this seat: settings applied, card closed. Recording the final state so the incident file is complete:

1. **Settings half**: `ADR maintainer approval` is in the `main` ruleset's required checks and Code-Owners review is enabled (maintainer, screenshot-confirmed 02:3xZ).
2. **Machine closure**: PR #7205 merged (`dff443386`) — the required-context registry now pins this check; silent removal from the required set turns CI red.
3. **ADR-0045 / ADR-0094**: with the card closed by the maintainer with no rollback ordered, both ADRs **stand as ratified**. Any future revisit is an ordinary ADR change through the now-enforced approval path.

Clearing the stale `needs-user-decision` label. The bypass class this card documented is now triple-locked: settings (human) + required-set pin (machine) + CODEOWNERS review routing (human).
